column6: Z_RST_N=0; Z_BUSRQ_N=1; Z_WAIT_N=2; CEN_GATE=3; TRAMP_EN=4; ESC_BREAK_EN=5; CONSOLE_OWN=8; PANEL_LOCK=9
column7: park/hold/trampoline/escape enables; Z_RST_N: set = assert Z80 CPU reset (ssp_tramp stretches the release to >=8 cpu_cen; T80 only, peripherals/MMU untouched); TRAMP_EN: arm reset-vector JP injection -- counts only if set while the Z80 reset is asserted, and the HARDWARE CLEARS IT when the 3 injected bytes have been delivered (G aaaa, D-02/D-39); write full values (a read-modify-write after completion would re-arm); Z_BUSRQ_N must be dropped no later than the reset release or the Z80 parks at the target; esc effective only with OSD OM (D-14); esc_break_en resets 1 (D-14; R25 CSV alignment); console_own resets 0 -- Z80 owns the SNAC at power (boot sovereignty R25: FW death never blocks the Z80); panel_lock gates RUN/START only (G-8); forced inactive when !SSP_ACTIVE
G aaaa / START trampoline target: JP target is injected on the first 3 reads after a Z80 reset armed via CTRL.TRAMP_EN (ssp_tramp, D-02)
